proposals.title: Item 4 – Independent Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons

proposals.title: Item 5 – Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Amend governing documents so holders of a combined 10% of outstanding stock can call a special shareholder meeting without court approval.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes it is important for shareholders to have the right to call a special shareholder meeting

proposals.title: Item 6 – Report on Scenario Analysis
proposals.topic_summary: Issue an audited report on whether a significant reduction in fossil fuel demand per the IEA Net Zero 2050 scenario would affect financial position and assumptions, by January 31, 2022.
proposals.evidence: the Board believes the requested audited report is unnecessary

proposals.title: Item 7 – Report on Environmental Expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Publish annual report of costs and actual benefits of voluntary environment-related activities exceeding compliance requirements.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes the proposal, therefore, is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Item 8 – Report on Political Contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Semiannually report on policies and on electoral contributions and non-deductible expenditures, including trade association and 501(c)(4) payments used for elections.
proposals.evidence: In the Board's view, this proposal is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Item 9 – Report on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Annually report on direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots communications policies, payments, recipients and oversight.
proposals.evidence: For this reason, and others stated above, the Board recommends voting against this proposal.

proposals.title: Item 10 – Report on Climate Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Evaluate and report on whether direct and trade association lobbying aligns with Paris Agreement goals and how misalignment risks are mitigated.
proposals.evidence: Considering the above, the Board believes the elements of this proposal have already been met or surpassed, and it is therefore unnecessary.
